scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder`
the navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
the dialog displays a current folder and proposed file name
the user switches to system-location navigation
the navigation pane displays system locations and drives
the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed
the user switches back to recent-folder navigation
the navigation pane displays libraries and recent folders
the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed
